title: Batch output as an appended list
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, let $S\subseteq J$, let $O$ be a list of rational numbers, and let $z_i,y_i,y'_i$ be three cube inputs for each $i<m$. The batch output auxiliary procedure, started with $O$, returns the reverse of $O$ followed by the list, in index order, of the rational restricted Fourier weight observations formed from $z_i,y_i,y'_i$ and the labels supplied by $f$.
